results.note: Jerome's Commentary on Jeremiah (Commentarii in Hieremiam libri VI) was translated into English by Michael Graves, IVP Academic (Ancient Christian Texts series), 2012.
Jerome's translation of Job (Vulgate) with preface. No separate English commentary on Job by Jerome exists; Jerome wrote prefaces but not a full exegetical commentary on Job.
Jerome's translation of Joshua (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Joshua; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Judges (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Judges; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Leviticus (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Leviticus; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Numbers (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Numbers; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Chronicles (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Chronicles; preface only.

Jerome's Psalms (Liber Psalmorum 1). This includes Jerome's translation of the Psalms (Psalterium iuxta Septuagintam, c. 383) and/or his Commentarioli in Psalmos (c. 389-391). Roger Pearse confirms the Commentarioli was never translated into English.
Jerome's translation of Ruth (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Ruth; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Samuel and Kings and Malachi (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write commentaries on these books; prefaces only.

Jerome's Commentaries on the Twelve Minor Prophets (all 12 prophetic books). Translated by Thomas P. Scheck et al., IVP Academic (New Studies in the Bible and Early Christianity), 2 volumes, 2016-2017.
Jerome's Preface to the Pentateuch (Praefatio in Pentateuchum). Included in NPNF2-06 (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 2, vol. 6), which is public domain.
Jerome's Preface to the Books of Solomon (Praefatio in libros Salomonis). Included in NPNF2-06 prefaces section, which is public domain.

Jerome's Synopsis Bibliothecae divinae (Synopsis of the Divine Library). This is Jerome's organizational framework for his biblical translations. Limited information available on English translation status; may be included in NPNF2-06 prefaces or remain untranslated.
Jerome's translation of Acts (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Acts; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Revelation (Vulgate, a revision of Victorinus of Pettau). Jerome revised but did not write an original commentary on Revelation. Roger Pearse confirms no English translation.
Jerome's translation of the Epistle of James (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on James; preface only.
Jerome's translation of the First Epistle of John (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 1 John; preface only.
Jerome's translation of the Second Epistle of John (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 2 John; preface only.
Jerome's translation of the Third Epistle of John (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 3 John; preface only.
Jerome's translation of the Epistle of Jude (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Jude; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Epistle to the Colossians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Colossians; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's First Epistle to the Corinthians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 1 Corinthians; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Second Epistle to the Corinthians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 2 Corinthians; preface only.
Jerome's Commentary on Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians (Commentarii in epistulam ad Ephesios). Translated by Ronald E. Heine, Oxford University Press (Origen and Jerome commentaries), 2002.
Jerome's Commentary on Paul's Epistle to the Galatians (Commentarii in epistulam ad Galatas). Translated by Andrew Cain, Fathers of the Church 121, 2010 (also translated by Thomas P. Scheck, 2010).
Jerome's translation of Paul's Epistle to the Hebrews (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Hebrews; preface only.
Jerome's Commentary on Paul's Epistle to Philemon (Commentarii in epistulam ad Philemonem). Translated by Thomas P. Scheck, 2010.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Epistle to the Philippians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Philippians; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Epistle to the Romans (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Romans; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's First Epistle to the Thessalonians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 1 Thessalonians; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Second Epistle to the Thessalonians (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 2 Thessalonians; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's First Epistle to Timothy (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 1 Timothy; preface only.
Jerome's translation of Paul's Second Epistle to Timothy (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 2 Timothy; preface only.
Jerome's Commentary on Paul's Epistle to Titus (Commentarii in epistulam ad Titum). Translated by Thomas P. Scheck, 2010.
Jerome's translation of the First Epistle of Peter (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 1 Peter; preface only.
Jerome's translation of the Second Epistle of Peter (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on 2 Peter; preface only.

Jerome's translation of the Gospel according to John (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on John; preface only. Jerome translated Origen's commentary on Luke but did not write original commentaries on the other Gospels.
Jerome's translation of the Gospel according to Luke (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Luke; preface only.

Jerome's translation of the Gospel according to Mark (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Mark (a spurious Commentary on Mark was once attributed to Jerome but is pseudepigraphal); preface only.
Jerome's Commentary on the Gospel according to Matthew (Commentarii in evangelium Matthaei). Translated by Thomas P. Scheck, Fathers of the Church 117, 2008.
Jerome's translation of Job continued (Liber Job 2, Vulgate). Same as workIdno 650; part of Jerome's translation of Job with preface, no separate English commentary.
Jerome's translation of Judith (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Judith; preface only.
Jerome's Psalms continued (Liber Psalmorum 2, Vulgate). Same as workIdno 656; Jerome's translation of the Psalms and/or his Commentarioli, which was never translated into English.
Jerome's translation of Tobit (Vulgate). Jerome translated but did not write a commentary on Tobit; preface only.
